Selecting jv-mode-sonar changed input placeholder to 'Opýtajte sa webu — medicína · EÚ…' (superset of spec 'Opýtajte sa webu…'). ui_bugs.issue: router.back() throws 'GO_BACK was not handled' when Jarvis is opened as the first route (e.g. deep-link or hard refresh). Under normal home→jarvis flow it works. Suggested fallback: if (router.canGoBack()) router.back(); else router.replace('/'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx:301
